verdict.rationale: Elicit's documented Systematic Reviews workflow covers search, title/abstract screening, an automated full-text screening step, and column-based data extraction across papers. It adds API control over screening criteria and extraction parameters, plus exportable screening-recommendation and extraction tables. Community reports of inaccurate summaries and hallucinated quotes raise doubts about accuracy, but they concern other features and do not contradict the screening workflow itself. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of screening and extraction accuracy at scale, and detailed docs on how screening criteria are defined and applied consistently in the UI.
